items.label: Breaking
items.text: Rapture countdown app adds 'Maybe Later' button after users request snooze functionality for imminence.

items.label: Developing
items.text: Newspaper prophecy study group discovers every headline can be about Revelation if you underline aggressively enough.

items.label: Update
items.text: Pastor advises members to keep selling assets 'as led' while quietly renewing church lease through 2030.

items.label: Report
items.text: End-times analyst explains multiple-resurrection schedule using color-coded chart; attendees ask if there's a calendar invite.

items.label: Watch
items.text: Silent Rapture reported in suburban cul-de-sac; missing residents later found at Costco sample station.

items.label: Breaking
items.text: Third Temple planners unveil modular altar kit: 'assembly required, anointing sold separately.'
